svg.title: Conv-DLGN pipeline
svg.desc: Native vector overview based on Petersen et al., Convolutional Differentiable Logic Gate Networks, NeurIPS 2024, Sections 3, 3.1, 3.2 and Appendix A.1, and repository 13710833172/Conv-DLGN commit 66d9af4ead9b4b289b4472a160ee06c4a22d319c. Panels a and b use the repository CIFAR-10-S profile (k=32, ox=1, tau=20). The local tree has 8 leaves and 7 learned binary gates with fixed local leaf indices and spatially shared parameters. OR pooling is max for soft activations and logical OR for Boolean activations. Residual initialization favors operator 3, identity A. Pooling values and RGB input are illustrative, not experimental results.

g.text: Per gate: k* = argmaxk θk → one Boolean operator
Keep sampled leaves, spatial sharing, and head connectivity
(c) Local logic trees, OR pooling, and residual initialization
One tree kernel: 8 leaves → 7 gates → 1 output
The same 7 gate parameter vectors θ are shared across all spatial locations
Start near the identity: f3(a,b) = a
